lines.text: You feed the output back into its own input before it has finished being an output. The oldest trick there is: run the circuit that makes a machine sing, backwards, to make one stop.
He built this to get something OUT of the signal.
It is engineering. You would not know the difference. Nobody in here ever did.
The organ chokes off. Somewhere below, the first wall lets go. The only clock in this building that was ever real starts to run.
On the reversed pre-roll, two service exits open before the transport reaches the sound of either door.
